safe.notes: Extracted netlist. off_*: rail 3.63 V, all controls low, clocks running, analog inputs 3.3 V, 0/27/85 C. stuck_on: all controls high at 3.63 V (no latch/short, current bounded). unpowered: rail via 1 Mohm, controls 0 (register isolation clamp), clocks running, pad-reachable inputs (detect TX_P/N) 3.63 V, internal analog nodes 0 V. unpowered_internal_driven is non-gating: internal RX/CTLE nodes forced to 3.63 V (only possible if the pad bypass were on with this island off) back-drive the rail through PMOS TG wells. Pad-level stress and brownout ramps are analog/pads scope.

atb_taps: VCTRL is the pt_pll_ring ATB_VCTRL node (timing tap)
clock_obs: QCK / RX ring FBCK -> WCLK_OBS via clk_obs (timing)

corner_set: tt/ss/ff x 22/32 C x 3.15/3.35 V (spec/tapeout-plan.md operating envelope), extracted netlist
excluded_coverage: Phase interpolator removed (lead decision): dual-loop CDR on a second pt_pll_ring instance (timing family, instantiated unchanged at integration) for half/quarter rate; full rate uses 8x oversampling with digital blind phase picking (no analog tracking)

The bang-bang pump is a separate weak pump on the PLL loop-filter node (ATB_VCTRL), not the PLL's own pump: pt_pll_ring has no hold input, so freq_hold gates its REF (at an FBCK falling edge) and clamps its pump bias IB_PLL (next FBCK rising edge) instead

Extracted closed loop uses an analog-behavioural phase detector (sample/holds + smooth logic, ~4 ns decision filter) as a stand-in for the RTL, which decides every 20-bit word; long windows, ppm, SSC and the frequency-counter hand-over (FLL) are behavioural (RTL + analog loop model)
The FLL hand-over step (cfg_fll_en) needs >100 us of ring time and is not simulated extracted
Cold acquisition is not simulated: VCTRL is pre-charged near the 625 MHz lock value before the frequency loop runs
pt_pll_ring changed several times during this pass (port list BAND -> N4/N8, pump 20 uA); each extracted result records the pll_ring.ext.spice sha256 it used
Ring port phase error of pt_pll_ring (37.7/83 deg at 742.5 MHz, timing README) is included in the extracted runs as-is
Timing closure of the QCK-domain RTL (480-810 MHz) is not established; the timing family will own the shared word-divider/capture front end (P3-6)
